<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pegs(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; out.append((min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
def ringpos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
print("pegs:",pegs(current_frame))
print("ring:",ringpos(current_frame))
# Test: click the ring center
r=ringpos(current_frame)
cr=(r[0]+r[2])//2; cc=(r[1]+r[3])//2
print("clicking ring at",cr,cc)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':cr,'col':cc}],intent='explore')
print("after ring click: done=",last_action_result.get('done'),"no_impact=",last_action_result.get('no_impact'),"board_changed=",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
print("pegs now:",pegs(current_frame))
print("ring now:",ringpos(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
